deals.description: So könnte dein Training bei DATRI BOXING aussehen 🥊 Coach Isa gibt die Anweisungen – danach wird das Gelernte direkt am Sandsack umgesetzt. deals.description: Save this spot for your next night out! 📌 📍 Cafe Milano The ultimate evening vibe: they have Happy Hour every single day from 5 PM to 10 PM, and you can play pool for absolutely free 🎱 It’s the perfect place to unwind with friends after a long day of classes. deals.title: @mariinvienna Angebot
deals.description: The Vienna Classic Days are taking over the Ringstraße with around 200 classic cars — and you can watch the parade completely for free! 📅 Saturday, August 22 🕕 From 6 PM 📍 Ringstraße, starting at Schwedenplatz Save this if you want to see Vienna in a whole different era 👀 Video credits: @Janka Burcinova & @Fastandvintage #vienna #austria #travel Quelle: TikTok @mariinvienna.
